newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish advertising budgets to rise 10 pct in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Danish advertising budgets to rise 10 pct in 1997.

text.p: Danish advertisers expect budgets to rise by 10 percent in 1997, according to a survey published by Denmark's marketing association on Friday.

The survey, conducted by Gallup using a sample of 253 companies, showed that Danish advertisers had solid confidence in growth but generally expected tougher competition in years to come with increasing pressure on prices.
It showed that most Danish advertisers intended to join the Internet in the near future.
Gallup estimated that Danish advertisers spent a total of approximately 18 billion crowns in 1995 on advertising in Denmark.
Data for 1996 is not available until June 1997.
